name: Survival Analysis (Kaplan-Meier, Cox)
when_to_use: The dependent variable is the time until an event (which may not have occurred for all cases — censoring); Kaplan-Meier estimates the survival curve, Cox models the effect of covariates on the event hazard.
notes: Models the time until an event happens (churn, failure, death) and measures the effect of factors on that time. Applications: time until subscription cancellation; time until equipment failure.

expected_input.question: How long until an event occurs, and which factors speed it up or delay it?

plain_explanation.purpose: Estimates how long it takes for an event to happen, even when some cases have not finished yet.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When the time until something happens matters: cancellation, failure, return.
plain_explanation.data_needed: For each item: observed time, whether the event occurred or not, and factors.
plain_explanation.example: Estimate how long a customer stays before canceling.
